existingSecret.description: Name of a Secret in the release namespace that you create; the chart never creates one. Empty turns the setting off.

global.description: Reserved by Helm for values shared with subcharts; this chart reads none.

tag.description: Image tag; empty means the chart's appVersion.

digest.description: Optional image digest, appended to the tag as @sha256:...

imagePullSecrets.description: Pull secrets for a private registry, as Kubernetes LocalObjectReference entries.

replicaCount.description: Server pods. One is the tested setup; more share Postgres for migrations, the scheduler and agent workers, but MCP, stream and in-flight limits are per process.

publicURL.description: SLASHOBSERVE_PUBLIC_URL: the http or https origin people open, with no path. Register <publicURL>/api/v1/auth/callback with the identity provider. The ingress host comes from it.

existingSecret.description: Secret holding the Postgres connection string for SLASHOBSERVE_DATABASE_URL. The chart ships no Postgres.

urlKey.description: Key of the connection string in that Secret.

directUrlKey.description: Key in database.existingSecret holding a connection string straight to Postgres, for SLASHOBSERVE_DATABASE_DIRECT_URL. Set it when database.urlKey points at a transaction-mode pooler such as PgBouncer. Empty leaves it unset.

clientSecretKey.description: Key of the client secret in that Secret.

allowedEmailDomains.description: SLASHOBSERVE_AUTH_ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS: domains that may sign in, or ["*"] for every account.

adminEmails.description: SLASHOBSERVE_ADMIN_EMAILS: addresses that are always Admins. Empty makes the earliest person to sign in the Admin.

secretKey.description: Secret holding SLASHOBSERVE_SECRET_KEY, which encrypts stored Grafana connection tokens and webhook signing secrets. Empty leaves it unset.

provider.description: SLASHOBSERVE_LLM_PROVIDER. Empty turns the agent off.

effort.description: SLASHOBSERVE_LLM_EFFORT, checked against the provider's list by the server.

apiKey.description: Secret holding the provider key, mounted as a file for SLASHOBSERVE_LLM_API_KEY_FILE.

outboundDomains.description: SLASHOBSERVE_OUTBOUND_DOMAINS: empty lets Admins manage the list in Settings; ["none"] or a list of domains locks it.

env.description: Extra container environment entries in Kubernetes EnvVar form, for any other SLASHOBSERVE_* setting and for the *Env passwords the datasources file references.

existingConfigMap.description: ConfigMap holding the datasources file; when set, datasources.datasources is ignored.

key.description: Key of the datasources file in the ConfigMap.

datasources.description: Entries of the datasources file, rendered into a ConfigMap. They never hold a secret: reference passwords by *Env names set through env, or by *File paths.

existingSecret.description: Secret holding the service-accounts file and its key files, mounted at /etc/slashobserve/service-accounts; each keyFile names a path in that directory. Empty sets no file.

fileKey.description: Key of the service-accounts file in that Secret.

internals.description: Provision the SlashObserve internals dashboard into folder SlashObserve. It needs a Prometheus datasource with uid prom that scrapes the server.

folders.description: Dashboard folders, each a ConfigMap of ObserveSpec .json files mounted as one directory of the provisioning directory.

directory.description: Directory name, which names the folder; write % as %25 and / as %2F.

configMap.description: ConfigMap whose keys are the .json files.

podAnnotations.description: Add prometheus.io/scrape, prometheus.io/port and prometheus.io/path to the pod.

interval.description: Scrape interval; empty uses the Prometheus default.

labels.description: Extra labels, such as the one your Prometheus selects ServiceMonitors by.

enabled.description: Create an Ingress for the publicURL host.

annotations.description: Controller annotations; turn off response buffering for the dashboard event stream.

tlsSecretName.description: TLS Secret for the host; empty sets no tls block.

create.description: Create a Kubernetes ServiceAccount; its token is never mounted.

name.description: ServiceAccount name; empty means the release's full name, or default when create is false.
